```{r}
dates_processing <- function(df) {

  df$Corrected_Dates <- as.Date(df$Dates[1], format = "%Y-%m-%d")
  df <- df %>% relocate(Corrected_Dates)
  
  for (row in 2:nrow(df)) {
    df$Corrected_Dates[row] <- NA
  }

  while (any(is.na(df$Corrected_Dates))) {
    for (row in 2:nrow(df)) {
      if (is.na(df$Corrected_Dates[row])) {
        diff <- difftime(df$Dates[row], df$Corrected_Dates[row - 1], units = "days")

        if (diff >= 60) {
          new_row <- data.frame(Dates = NA, Corrected_Dates = df$Corrected_Dates[row - 1] + 30)
          df <- bind_rows(df[1:(row - 1), ], new_row, df[row:nrow(df), ]) %>%
            arrange(Corrected_Dates)
          break
          
        } else {
          df$Corrected_Dates[row] <- df$Corrected_Dates[row - 1] + 30
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return(df)
}
```

```{r}
S1 <- dates_processing(S1)
S5 <- dates_processing(S5)
long_COWG <- dates_processing(long_COWG)
GAL <- dates_processing(GAL)
Confluence <- dates_processing(Confluence)
Amous <- dates_processing(Amous)
```


```{r}
undetermined_method <- function(df){
  
  levels(df$O2_method) <- c(levels(df$O2_method), "Undetermined_O2_method")
  df$O2_method[ is.na( df$O2_method ) ] <- "Undetermined_O2_method"
  
  levels(df$Antimoine_method) <- c(levels(df$Antimoine_method), "Undetermined_Antimoine_method")
  df$Antimoine_method[ is.na( df$Antimoine_method ) ] <- "Undetermined_Antimoine_method"
  
  levels(df$Baryum_method) <- c(levels(df$Baryum_method), "Undetermined_Baryum_method")
  df$Baryum_method[ is.na( df$Baryum_method ) ] <- "Undetermined_Baryum_method"
  
  levels(df$Cadmium_method) <- c(levels(df$Cadmium_method), "Undetermined_Cadmium_method")
  df$Cadmium_method[ is.na( df$Cadmium_method ) ] <- "Undetermined_Cadmium_method"
  
  levels(df$Calcium_method) <- c(levels(df$Calcium_method), "Undetermined_Calcium_method")
  df$Calcium_method[ is.na( df$Calcium_method ) ] <- "Undetermined_Calcium_method"
  
  levels(df$Chrome_method) <- c(levels(df$Chrome_method), "Undetermined_Chrome_method")
  df$Chrome_method[ is.na( df$Chrome_method ) ] <- "Undetermined_Chrome_method"
  
  levels(df$Cuivre_method) <- c(levels(df$Cuivre_method), "Undetermined_Cuivre_method")
  df$Cuivre_method[ is.na( df$Cuivre_method ) ] <- "Undetermined_Cuivre_method"
  
  levels(df$Étain_method) <- c(levels(df$Étain_method), "Undetermined_Étain_method")
  df$Étain_method[ is.na( df$Étain_method ) ] <- "Undetermined_Étain_method"
  
  levels(df$Molybdène_method) <- c(levels(df$Molybdène_method), "Undetermined_Molybdène_method")
  df$Molybdène_method[ is.na( df$Molybdène_method ) ] <- "Undetermined_Molybdène_method"
  
  levels(df$Nickel_method) <- c(levels(df$Nickel_method), "Undetermined_Nickel_method")
  df$Nickel_method[ is.na( df$Nickel_method ) ] <- "Undetermined_Nickel_method"
  
  levels(df$Plomb_method) <- c(levels(df$Plomb_method), "Undetermined_Plomb_method")
  df$Plomb_method[ is.na( df$Plomb_method ) ] <- "Undetermined_Plomb_method"
  
  levels(df$Strontium_method) <- c(levels(df$Strontium_method), "Undetermined_Strontium_method")
  df$Strontium_method[ is.na( df$Strontium_method ) ] <- "Undetermined_Strontium_method"
  
  levels(df$Thallium_method) <- c(levels(df$Thallium_method), "Undetermined_Thallium_method")
  df$Thallium_method[ is.na( df$Thallium_method ) ] <- "Undetermined_Thallium_method"
  
  levels(df$Titane_method) <- c(levels(df$Titane_method), "Undetermined_Titane_method")
  df$Titane_method[ is.na( df$Titane_method ) ] <- "Undetermined_Titane_method"
  
  levels(df$Zinc_method) <- c(levels(df$Zinc_method), "Undetermined_Zinc_method")
  df$Zinc_method[ is.na( df$Zinc_method ) ] <- "Undetermined_Zinc_method"
  
  return(df)
}
```

```{r}
S1 <- undetermined_method(S1)
S5 <- undetermined_method(S5)
COWG <- undetermined_method(COWG)
GAL <- undetermined_method(GAL)
Confluence <- undetermined_method(Confluence)
Amous <- undetermined_method(Amous)
```
